explication: ARES is an operator-directed red-team engagement and continuous security-validation platform. The principal workflow is to authenticate and configure an engagement, discover and fingerprint targets, plan authorized attack steps, execute modules within scope, then validate and present findings. The graph also preserves the documented attack-path, collaboration, replay, reporting, and integration capabilities. Source excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted; some capability branches are supported by the README and repository tree rather than sampled implementation.
